title: $S^3$: A Smooth Simulation Surrogate for Optimizing Discrete Abstractions of Dynamical Systems
abstract: arXiv:2608.15920v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Intelligent systems are increasingly deployed in safety-critical settings with black-box controllers, including neural networks. The properties and behaviors of these end-to-end systems can be studied with abstraction-based methods that replace them with simpler finite models. Constructing such abstractions requires balancing the soundness of over-approximating the dynamical system against conservatism, which manifests as spurious or excessive nondeterministic behaviors. Bi-simulation theory provides principled metrics for characterizing these relationships, but does not prescribe how to construct sound abstractions with minimal conservatism. We fill this gap with a smooth simulation surrogate ($S^3$) --- a differentiable objective that approximates the reverse simulation metric used to quantify conservatism. translated_title: $S^3$：一种用于优化动力学系统离散抽象的光滑仿真替代方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15920v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：智能系统越来越多地部署在具有黑盒控制器（包括神经网络）的安全关键环境中。这些端到端系统的属性和行为可以通过基于抽象的方法进行研究，这些方法用更简单的有限模型替换它们。构建此类抽象需要在过度逼近动力学系统的合理性与保守性之间取得平衡，保守性表现为虚假或过度的非确定性行为。双仿真理论为表征这些关系提供了原则性指标，但并未规定如何构建具有最小保守性的合理抽象。我们通过一种光滑仿真替代方法（$S^3$）填补了这一空白——这是一种可微的目标函数，近似用于量化保守性的反向仿真指标。结合基于泰勒模型的可达性分析，$S^3$ 支持基于梯度的抽象参数优化，同时保持合理性。
tldr: 本文提出一种光滑仿真替代方法（$S^3$），通过可微目标函数优化动力学系统离散抽象的参数，在保持合理性的同时最小化保守性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a smooth simulation surrogate ($S^3$), a differentiable objective that optimizes abstraction parameters for dynamical systems while preserving soundness and minimizing conservatism.
